FX Unit Yuki - The Henshin Engine.name: FX-Unit Yuki: The Henshin Engine
FX Unit Yuki - The Henshin Engine.summary: Take control of Yuki and set of on a digital journey of pixel proportions! Get Ready for FX-Unit Yuki!!! 8 levels of hardcore retro action with Power-Ups, Varying Stage Types and Multiple Endings accompanied by an Amazing Sound Design.

Pop'n Magic.name: Pop 'n Magic
Pop'n Magic.summary: A static screen action game in the style of Bubble Bobble or Don Doko Don, Pop 'n Magic allows you to trap enemies by firing your wand at them, then pick them up and throw them across the screen to destroy them. The bubbles they are trapped in are specific colours and care must be taken not to throw two of the same colour together as this will release the (now quite upset) creatures inside.
